Fuji Electric.why: Supplies substation equipment, switchboards and UPS for data centers and semiconductor factories, and makes power semiconductors; data center build-outs drive its power supply and facility systems orders.
Fuji Electric.evidence: Fuji Electric 1Q FY2026 results presentation (07-30-2026): strong orders in the power supply and facility systems business on higher demand for domestic and overseas data center-related and overseas semiconductor factories.

players.product: Power supply and facility systems for data centers and semiconductor factories: substation equipment (switchboards, molded transformers) and UPS

quarterly_data.quarter: Fuji Electric press release: Capital Investment for Expanding Switchboard Production (12-20-2024)
quarterly_data.signal: Fuji Electric will expand switchboard and UPS production at its Kobe Factory and install skid system production equipment, citing rapid growth in demand for substation equipment and power supply systems for internet data centers driven by generative AI; it expects orders for internet data center and semiconductor factory applications in the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027 to be roughly double those of the fiscal year ended March 31, 2024. Capacity for switchboards and UPSs at Kobe to rise 50%, time from pre-shipment testing to on-site installation to fall 40%; construction scheduled June 2025 to September 2026
